instances.why: chart.line@1 permits .lines > .pt only, no series grouping. One root cannot distinguish and connect three independent five-point sequences while sharing an axis. Flattening fifteen points would create false connectors; three overlaid roots would each own duplicate/shared axes without a contract marker to suppress them selectively. Do not add fake .series/.multi variants.
instances.required_markup: A new approved multiseries line contract would need a root holding series ×3, each containing its own complete .pt list, and one shared .axis / legend-name mechanism. Existing chart.line@1 cannot carry this.
